You’ll currently find her work on IGN and Fangoria alongside Mashable, but she also has bylines at Rock Paper Shotgun, Collider, Screen Rant, and more. When it comes to finding a good robot vacuum deal, there's no need to wait for Prime Big Deal Days.

Amazon already has plenty of deals worth checking out, including a huge 40% discount on the Eufy E25 robot vacuum and mop. As of Sept. 21, this cleaner has plummeted to $599.98 at the retailer.

Usually it's priced at $999.99, so you're saving just over $400 through this offer, which isn't too bad considering the October Prime Day sale hasn't even kicked off yet. On top of that, it's just a couple of dollars away from its lowest-ever price (listed by price tracker camelcamelcamel at $597.99), so the timing couldn't be better.

Fitted with both a vacuum and a mop, the Eufy E25 is a versatile cleaner that can tidy up everything from wood to tile to carpets. Its powerful 20,000 Pa suction can lift dust, crumbs, pet hair, and more stuck in your floors, while its roller mop scrubs with 10N of downward pressure to lift stains from your hard surfaces. Plus, the HydroJet Deep Cleaning System cleans the roller mop in real-time, using a water tank and scraper, to keep it fresh for each mop.

This robot vacuum also features an extendable CornerRover arm that reaches edges and corners for greater cleaning coverage, as well as Obstacle Avoidance technology. With this, it can recognize and steer clear of objects in its way, so it won't be slowed down or stalled while completing a full clean.
